tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rab 'byams phrin las snang ba'i nyin byed zhes bya ba bzhugs so// //

༄༅/ /rdo rje nyi mas 'khrul rtog mun bsal ste/ /ye shes snang bas dngos grub kun dga'i skyes/ /sbyin mdzad bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar/ /btud nas phrin las bzhi yi sreg blug spel/ /de yang snying po'i rgyud las/ dbyibs dang kha dog mtshan ldan par/ /zhal du gyur pa'i me bus la/ /bza' btung bro ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /las bzhi'i mchod pa rab tu sbyin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro kun 'dus rdo rje phag mo'i lha sngags la brten pa'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po ni/ las lnga char gyi sngon 'gror sa yi cho ga bya ba ste/ so so'i dus skabs la bab pa dang*/ las gang yang rung bar bsngags shing rung ba'i gnas su dkar gtor dang*/ gser skyems bshams la/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor phyag rgya gcig pa'i bskyed bzlas sam/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje phag mo khros ma nag mo'i skur gyur/ oṃ badzra bhā ra he kro dhī kā li ha ri ni sa a bai sha ya: zhes brgya rtsa tsam bzlas pas nga rgyal bzung la/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ /bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma dzaḥ sa spyan drangs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro sogs gsum gyis gtor ma bsngos la/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /dkyil 'khor don du sa phyogs 'di/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ /sarba bhū ta gatstsha sa gnang zhing rang gnas gzhi der thim par bsam la gser skyems dang gtor ma phyi rol du gtsang sar phul/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i thal mo sa la reg pas rtsa sngags brgya rtsa brgyad dang*/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dhā hūm̐ phaṭa:

lan bdun bzlas la kun rdzob kyis sbyang ba dang*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa'i chos nyid la dran par bzhag nas/ shu n+ya tā 'i sngags brjod pas don dam gyis sbyangs ba'o/ /gnyis pa la lnga las/ dang po zhi ba'i sbyin sreg la/ cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /dang po ni/ zla ba yar ngo bkra shis pa'i nyi ma'i drod kyi cha la shis pa'i sa la 'jam zhing khod snyoms pa'i stegs bu dkar po khru gang las mi chung ba gru bzhi pa byas pa'i ngogs su rdul tshon kha dog dkar pos chos 'byung bsnol ma rdo rwa me ri dang bcas pa'i lte bar padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su bam̐ yig rigs kyi kha dog can dang*/ 'dab ma 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i srog gi mtshon byed ha ri ni sa'i yig 'bru bzhi 'god/ bcad tshon kyang dmar skya las nag po sogs tshon sel gyis ma phog par gal che/ thab kyi khar bal bu/ lcang ma/ 'om bu sogs 'o ma can gyi bud shing ngam/ ba yi lci ba kha khyer cha zlum por brtsegs la tsandan dkar po'i chu 'o ma dang sbyar bas bran/ shar lhor me tshang bca'/ thab stegs kyi grwa bzhir mda' bzhi btsugs pa srad bu dkar po las so so la rang mdog dgos mchan/ bsnol mar sprel ba la dar dkar pos dgab/ de'i shar lho'i zur du mda' dar dmar po gzug /de dang nye bar rang gi mdun du dgang blugs kha sbyar la rdor dril thod rnga/ bsang chu/ me tog gi snod thugs dam bskul ba'i rdzas yungs kar sogs dang*/ rang gi g.yas su sman gtor rakta nyer spyod/ 'bras mchan dngul gyi me tog dkar po rnams bsres pa'i mar dkar gyi gtor zlum ril bus bskor ba dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ g.yon du bsregs rdzas mar khu/ las mthun gyi yam shing mtho gang ba'i rtser mngar gsum dang mar khus sbags pa dang*/ de bzhin du mngar gsum sbyar ba'i zhun mar dang*/ khyad par gyi rdzas til dkar po dang*/

gur gum 'o mar bcas pa'i zho zan/ 'bras ma grug pa dang*/ so ba gra ma med pa dang*/ nas dang*/ sran ma dang*/ gro dang*/ durwa dang*/ ku sha dang*/ gzhan yang bshal sman dang*/ dug rigs ma yin pa'i rin chen 'bru sman sna tshogs sbyar ba rnams 'jig rten pa dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rim pas nyis rim du 'god/ spros pa la dga' na dar dkar gyi na bza' dang*/ shel gtso bor gyur pa'i rin po che dkar po'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i chas zhugs dang*/ sgrub pa po kha shar du phyogs pas sems skyil gyis ku sha sogs gtsang zhing 'jam pa'i stan la dang ba'i sems gyis 'khod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ brgyud 'debs skyabs sems nas brtsams bzlas pa mchod bstod bar bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bya/ rab gnas dang sgrub mchod 'brel ba'i tshe/ oṃ bam̐ badzra bhā ra he kro dhī kā li ha ri ni sa a bai sha ya: zhes brjod pas/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phag mo khros ma nag mo gnyis pa'i rnam pas thon nas sbyin sreg gi las rim la 'jug par mos la/ bsang chu sgrub pa las byang ltar rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ sa karma dhā ki ni hūm̐ phaṭa: cung zad bzlas pas bgegs bsang ba'i nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis rlabs/ rdor dril/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐ zhes pas rdo rje snying gar gsor/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe āḥ sa dril bu dkur brten/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa badzra sā bhā wa atma ko3 ha ྃ gis rdor dril bsnol ma'i 'khyud rgya dang bcas dam tshig gsum bzung*/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thog mar mchod bsreg gi rdzas rnams bsang chus 'thor te/ mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐: gnas khang dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas khang : ye shes bkod pa 'byams klas 'od 'bar dbus: nyer spyod 'dod yon drag po'i nyer spyod kun: bde stong mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por gyur:

oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe a lo ke gandhe nai bi dya shabda pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa dharma dha tu sarba pū dza hūm̐: zhes phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ hrī ṭha: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ka pā la rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrī ṭha: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba ling ta sarba karma gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: nang mchod sngags rnams so sor lan gsum res byin gyis brlabs/ bsreg rdzas rnams bdud rtsis bran la rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas reg cing*/ oṃ oṃ swā hā/ phyag rgya de nyid kyis yam shing la/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhun mar la/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ 'bru rnams la/ oṃ dziṃ swā hā/ rdzas gzhan rnams la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa'i nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i bcud mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa so so'i las sgrub pa la thogs pa med pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ swā am̐ ha/ zhes lan bdun dang*/ oṃ bi ma la agna ye swā hā/ zhes sogs rdzas sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ gtsub shing las byung ba'am dge 'dun gyi tshang mang las byung ba'i me du ba med pa'i dpal 'bar thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung ste g.yas su bskor zhing sbar la/ oṃ badzra dzñā na ḍā ki ni dzwa la ram̐ḥ lan gsum rlung g.yab kyis g.yab cing*/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod/ hūm̐ lan bdun bzlas pa'i blugs gzar gyis mar khus kyang gso bar bya'o/ /de nas ku sha sngo ljang dri ma med pa la las bum gyi chus bran te/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li sarba bighnān sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsangs la/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin/

/dkon mchog gsum ni mnyes byed pa/ /sa las skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*/ /bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni/ /zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ /swā hā zhes brjod de/ ku sha gnyis gnyis rtse mo gshibs pa dag sgrub pa po'i g.yon ngos kyi thab kyi kha khyer nas rtse mo shar lho nub byang du bstan pa dgram zhing rgyab ma rnams kyi rtse mo mdun ma rnams kyi rtsa bas non par bya zhing*/ slar thab tu rtse mo shar du bstan pa'i ku sha ba lang gi rna ba lta bu ha cang mi ring bas g.yogs so/ /de nas thab bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung kha dog dkar zhing dbyibs zlum pa/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma'i lte bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor zhing grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba rgya dpangs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du me yi dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du raṃ dkar po las dbyug tho dkar po raṃ gyis mtshan par gyur te/ de las me lha dkar po drang srong gi cha byad can/ sha skem pa/ tshangs pa'i skud pa dkar po dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang po dbyug to/ gnyis pa na bgrang phreng*/ g.yon dang po na ril ba spyi blugs/ g.yon gnyis pa skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya bcas drang srong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor bar gyur/ de'i sbyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ /bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs par bsam la/ lag g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mthe bong g.yab cing*/ mda' dar bzung la/ oṃ/ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog

/bsreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'bar ba'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ pā ba ka agne ye a gatstsha ya ma mchog gi skabs/ shantiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mda' dar g.yab/ zhes mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la las bum gyi chu dang las sngags kyis bgegs sprad/ rgyas pa'i skabs/ oṃ badzra puṣtiṃ ku ru oṃ: dbang gi skabs/ wa shaṃ ku ru ho: drag po la/ gatstsha ya sarba sha trun mā ra ya phaṭa: aṅku sha dza: lcags kyu'-i phyag rgyas bkug /oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐: zhags pa'i rgyas bkug /oṃ badzra spho ṭa bam̐: lcags sgrog gi rgyas gnyis med du byas/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ dril bu'i rgyas dgyes pa bskyed/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur ba'i: spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang dam pa 'dis: mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig: oṃ swā bhā wa shuddha swā hā: bdag cag me tog spos rab dang : sbyin bsreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod: oṃ badzra puṣpe pra titstsha ho: nas shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐: gzi brjid chen po me yi lha: 'dod pa thams cad stsol mdzad pa: bdag gzhan don grub sa la bzhugs: 'dzin byed me lha nyid la 'dud: ces bstod/ bum chus gtor zhing*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas dbang gi lha tshogs byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa spros te dbang bskur/ oṃ ratna a laṃ kā ra swā hā: des de rnams kyi rgyan btags par bsam/ de nas byon skyems ni/ me lha zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pa'i cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la raṃ yig 'od zer gyi phung por 'bar bas mtshan pas sreg blugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs te gsol bar bsam la/ drag po'i skabs khros pa'i zhal rab tu gdangs pa'i ljags zhes dmigs bsal kha bsgyur dgos/

mchan/ lag gnyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur gyis dgang blugs bzung nas/ oṃ bi ma le agna ye swā hā/ zhes g.yas pa'i blugs gzar bdun gyis g.yon pa'i dgang gzar bkang ba'i gzar bu kha sbyar pus mo'i phyir mi 'da' bas g.yas su bskor zhing*/ oṃ pā pa ka agna ye zhes pa'i mthar/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa lta bu spel tshig sbrel bas 'thus/ tshul de ltar lan gsum du 'bul zhing me pra brtag /de nas rdzas rnams las zhu ba'i rang bzhin can rnams zhal du/ yam shing*/ durwa/ ku sha sogs 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ zho zan dang*/ til sogs phyag gis mtshon par 'bul bar mos te/ lag gis bzung du btub pa rnams g.yas pa'i mtheb srin sbyar ba'i mchog sbyin gyi tshul dang*/ de las gzhan pa rnams blugs gzar gyis 'bul zhing*/ 'bul sngags dang go rim ni/ yam shing*/ oṃ bo shi hasta badzra swā hā/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mar khu/ oṃ bi ma agna ye swā hā/ 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad= til/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swā hā/ sdig pa thams cad= zho zan dang zas mchog /oṃ sarba saṃ ba de swā hā/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa= 'bras/ oṃ badzra puṣta ya swā hā/ bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa la= so ba/ oṃ badzra bi dza ya swā hā/ nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa la= nas/ oṃ ma hā be ga ya swā hā/ shugs phun sum tshogs pa la= sran ma/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ stobs phun sum tshogs pa la= gro/ oṃ badzra ghasma ri ye swā hā/ nad med pa phun sum tshogs pa la= durba/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ tshe ring ba phun sum tshogs pa la= ku sha/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swā hā/

srung ba phun sum tshogs pa la= rdzas gzhan rnams la/ oṃ a ha ra a ha ra phu me ma hā dar be sha shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bdun la sogs pas phul ba'i mthar bdag cag dpon slob sogs gong byon skyems skabs ltar phul/ de dag gi skabs su dmigs pa ni bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rtsa gzhung las/ /sreg rdzas bdud rtsi phul bas me lha mnyes te: 'od zer byung ste bdag gi thugs kar phog pas: lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa bsregs ste: slar 'od zer chu rgyun lta bu'i bkrus par bsam ste: bshang ba'i lam nas 'thon par bsam pa'o/ yang na me lha'i 'od kyis lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa la sogs pa snying ga nas brtsams ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bton te rdzas la bstims pas mchod pa ni man ngag go /de bzhin du nad dang dgra dang 'byung po'i nad la sogs pa thams cad la'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /gal te slob dpon la sogs pa'i ched du byed na'ang de bzhin du bya'o/ /zhes skabs 'dir spro na dngos grub blang ba'i don du dgang blugs kyang 'bul bar gsungs pas rten 'brel du bris 'bur ci rigs 'bul na legs shing ma 'byor kyang chad skyon med do/ /gang ltar yang*/

ā ka ro 'i sngags lan gsum gyi gtor ma 'bul/ skabs 'dir thab tu 'bul mi dgos/ bstod pa ni/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras: me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog: 'byung po yongs su skyobs pa'i phyir: thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa: rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul: nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od: bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar: mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan: thabs kyis sprul pa'i theg pa bcibs: bgrang phreng 'dzin zhing rig sngags gsung : bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gundhe bsnams: chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la sim: nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod: 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das: zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che: de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: yig brgya brjod la nongs pa bshags/ yungs kar thab tu gtor la/ na mo/ rig pa'i rgyal po khyod kyis las thams cad byed pas bsreg rdzas lha yi zhal du 'bul ba dang*/ me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i thog drangs pa'i mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi rgyas pa'i skabs tshe dang bsod nams ye shes thams cad rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ dbang la 'khor dang bcas par brtan g.yo srid zhi'i yon tan thams cad wā shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes dang*/ drag po la/ 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ zhi ba la/ nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mum̐ḥ ye shes kyi me lha thabs kyi shar lho gshegs par gyur/ gnyis pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa la/ gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed pa ni/ ku sha'i 'thor g.yab kyis bsang chu 'thor zhing*/ las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ āḥ stong nyid 'od gsal dbyings kyi mkha':

thig le chen po'i klong yangs su: rig pa'i ye shes rang snang ba: las kyi dngos grub ji snyed kun: mos pa bzhin du 'byung ba'i gnas: mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs rdo rje'i thab: gos dkar yum gyi ngo bo nyid: dam tshig me lha'i lto ba dang : gnyis med me lce 'khyil ba'i dbus: bhrūm̐ las drag po'i gzhal med khang : zhes pa nas/ sna tshogs padma 'dab bzhi gsal: zhes pa'i bar rtsa ba'i phrin las ltar ro/ /sbyin sreg rkyang pa'i skabs brten pa lha bskyed nas spyan 'dren pa yin mod/ 'dir sgrub mchod dang rjes su 'brel ba'i dbang du byas te/ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhengs shig bla ma yi dam lha sogs/ e a ralli hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: zhes pa'i bar spyan 'dren gyi tshig brjod pa dang bstun las rdor gyis lha sngags rnams brjod cing sgrub dkyil las me tog gis mtshon par spyan drangs pa slob dpon la g.yas su bskor te g.yon phyogs nas phul ba las me tog thab tu dor ba dang mnyam du lha so so'i sngags brjod mthar gsal gdab pa ni/ bde stong ye shes rdo rje'i sngags: zhes pa nas/ sarba maṇḍa la ma hā su kha atma ko3 ham̐: zhes phag mo rigs lnga/ gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro las dang dam tshig gi ḍā ki'i bskyed pa'i bar dang*/ hūm̐: yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa ya ི sogs/ hūm̐: bde gshegs kun gyi sogs kyis bstod pa'ang bya/ de nas/ dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pa'i lha thams cad las/ rgyas pa'i skabs/ gser gtso ma sku'i 'od zer zhing thams cad du khyab par 'char bas rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzad pa zhes bsgyur/ dbang gi skabs/ rjes su chags pa'i 'od zer dmar po bdud rtsi'i zil mngar can zhing thams cad du sprau bas rab 'byams dbang gi phrin las mdzad par dmigs/ zla ba chu shel lta bu'i 'od zer dkar po'i phreng ba zhing thams cad du khyab par 'char bas zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad par bsam/ byon skyems ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pas cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags rdo rje dkar po'i rnam pa can dang*/

gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la hūm̐ yig 'od zer gyi phung po 'bar bas mtshan pas sreg blugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs te gsol bar bsam la/ oṃ bam̐ badzra bhā ra he kro dhī kā li ha ri ni sa a bai sha ya: zhes rtsa sngags bdun gyis dgang zhing*/ mthar/ a bai sha ya dhā ka dhā ki nī sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes lan gcig sbyar bas phul/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod sogs spel tshig me lha'i skabs ltar sbyar/ de nas yam shing la sogs pa'i rdzas gzhan rnams rtsa sngags bhā ra ha ི'i mthar/ dhā ka dhā ki nī sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes lha sngags lan re'i mthar/ oṃ be she hasta badzra swā hā/ zhes rdzas sngags bcu sogs ji ltar rigs pa sbyar nas phul la/ spel tshig gong ltar sprel/ tshul de lta bu'i rdzas gzhan rnams kyang brgya'am sum cu nyer gcig sogs skabs dang bstun ste phul/ bsnyen pa sogs kyi kha skong la/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad sogs bzlas pa'i nyes skyon thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā: zhes dmigs bsal dang*/ rdzas til gtso bor 'bul ba sogs 'dod gsol dang rdzas me skong skabs ltar 'bul kyang legs/ rdzas re dang sngags re re spel la 'bul/ sngags nyung la rdzas mang bdag gis spangs/ rdzas nyung la sngags mang ba ni 'gal ba med do gsungs/ rdzas rnams rdzogs nas las 'chol ba'i tshe bsab mi dgos/ sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par bsam la dmigs pa'i gsal snang la rtse gcig tu sems 'dzin pa ni rno la ngar gyis gdags pa bzhin no/ /rgyas pa'i skabs/ thab kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsi rin po ches gang ba 'dzin pas zla ba ser po la gnas pa'i sgrub bya'i steng phyogs nas bdud rtsi dang rin po che'i char bab pas de'i lus dang*/ khyim gang ste tshe dang bsod nams nor dang longs spyod thams cad rgyas par bsam/

dbang gi skabs/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas gang 'dod par rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus par bsam/ drag po'i skabs/ lha tshogs rnams las 'od zer nag po me lce lta bu 'phros pas mtshon cha'i char bab pas dgra bgegs brlag par bsam/ slar yang dgang blugs sngar bzhin 'bul/ oṃ badzra wāst+ra ya swā hā/ zhes gos gsar pa dang*/ oṃ badzra tambu la ya swā hā/ zhes rdo thal med pa'i so rtsi 'bul/ gter gzhung gi tshogs bsdus skabs 'dir sbyar zhing tshogs phud thab kyi dkyil dang*/ lhag ma thab kyi zur du 'bul/ nang dang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod byas pas de dang de'i sbyin sreg kyang zhar byung du 'grub cing dgos pa che bar gsungs pas/ tshogs kyi bdud rtsi cung zad rol ste/ hoḥ snying dbus mi shig thig le'i klong : stong gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i klong : dbyings kyi pho nya 'du 'bral med: ye shes mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'phro: spyi bor dza landha ra sogs: rtsa khams gnas yul dur khrod du: 'gro 'ong rlung gis las kun byed: bde stong thig le dkar dmar gzugs: dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs dang bcas: til gyi gong bu kha bye ltar: snang stong 'od skur shigs se shig: a ham̐ sngags kyi rang sgrar bcas: bde chen bdud rtsi'i bsreg blugs rol: yul dang dbang po gnyis med par: dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod pas bskang : tha mal snang zhen nyams chags bshags: rtsa rlung thig le'i bar chad sol: dga' ba bzhi yi ye shes spor: stong pa bzhi yi 'od gsal bskyed: thams cad ka dag gnyug ma'i ngang : lhun gyis grub pa'i mchog dbang bskur: badzra dhā tu dzñā na lo ka dhā ki nī maṇḍa la ma hā su kha pū dza hoḥ zhes brjod cing bsam/ drod thob pas gsang ba'i tshogs 'khor rdo rje'i glu gar bcas dgos par gsungs kyang thun mong du ma da na dang*/ zhun mar cung zad kyi sku mnyes snying gar byugs shing*/

hoḥ shes rab padma e yi dbyings: thabs kyi rdo rje wam̐ yig gzugs: snyoms 'jug bde ba'i mchod sprin gyis: phung khams skye mched ye shes dbyings: dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma: zag med dgyes pa chen po bskyed: snang sems 'pho ba'i bag chags sbyongs: zag bcas thig le sred zhen sgrol: rgyu 'bras gnyis su ma phyed pa'i: bcu drug dga' ba'i pho nya mos: lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes spel: dwangs ma mi shig gsum ldan gyis: 'ja' lus rdo rje'i go 'phang la: mngon par byang chub dngos grub stsol: ma hā su kha siddhi sa ma ya a ham̐: zhes pa'i don sgom nas mthar thug de kho na nyid dbyings rig dbyer med kyi ngang du mnyam par bzhag pas so so'i dbang po'i khyad par bzhin dngos dang rjes mthun gyi dgos pa dang phan yon thob par 'gyur ro/ oṃ sarba dzñā na dhā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pas mchod/ bde gshegs kun gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan sogs kyis bstod/ ma rnyed yongs su ma tshang dang sogs/ yig brgyas nongs pa bshags/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mūṃ zhes brjod cing*/ sgrub mchod dang sbrail tshe/ dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du gshegs par bsam zhing*/ maṇḍal me tog gis mtshon par sgrub dkyil ga la bar spyan drangs/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa rang la thim par bsam/ sreg rkyang gi skabs su ni ye shes pa chos dbyings su gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ 'on kyang bla med mthun mong ma yin pa'i skabs 'dir dam dbye gnyis med dbugs rngub pa'i sbyor ba dang bstun rang la bstim pas mi shig pa'i thig ler ro gcig tu bsam kyang legs so/ /gsum pa ni/ las sngags kyis bsangs/ /badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa me lha ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/

de nas dgang blugs/ me lha zhal cung zad 'dzum pa dang bcas pas sogs gshegs skyems bdun lnga gsum gang 'os 'bul/ gos zung dang*/ so rtsi bcas 'das pa'i me lha'i skabs ltar dang rdzas lhag rnams so so'i sngags lnga'am gsum re'i mthar/ oṃ bā ba ka agna ye bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas thog drangs mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis: rdzas dang yo byad ma tshogs pa dang : ting 'dzin ma gsal ba dang : cho ga lhag pa dang : nyams pa dang : lha gong 'og nor ba thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā: zhes sbyar bas 'bul/ rdzas so sor mi ldang na gcig tu bsdus nas 'bul kyang rung bar gsungs/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyun du byed na rdzas lhag bzhag rgyu rung*/ mi byed na skabs 'di nyid du zhib par 'bul gsungs so/ /mthar/ oṃ agne de wa puṣpe nas shabda pra tītstsha hoḥ zhes nyer spyod kyi mchod cing*/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod/ a ka ro sa sngar smos pa'i gtor ma thab tu 'bul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ ma rnyed yongs suu ma tshang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrub byed sreg bya za ba gshegs/ /ji bzhin dus su tshur byon la/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrub/ oṃ mūm̐: zhes me lha ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ /dam tshig gi me lha rang gi snying gar thim par bsam zhing*/ dge rtsa bsngo smon dang shis brjod kyis mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ /de ltar sbyin sreg byas pa'i me dkrug brdal sogs mi bya bar rang zhir 'jug /long skabs ma byung na 'o ma dang dri bzang gi chus gzhil/ thal sol rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bo chen por bskyal lo/ /gnyis pa rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg ni/ sa chog zhi ba'i skabs ltar sngon du 'gro bas/

tshong 'dus dang rgyal po'i bang mdzod kyis stegs la/ rdul tshon ser po'i mdog can gyi thab bcad tshon dur smrig gis byas pa'i steng du rtar ga dang*/ shug pa sogs 'bras can mdog ser zhing dri bzang ba 'o ma can gang 'byor gy-i bud shing gru bzhi par brtsigs/ gur gum gyi chab kyis bran pa khru do tsam brtsigs/ rdzas spyir snga ma ltar tshogs pa dang*/ bye brag tu tshe rgyas pa la durba/ shes rab rgyas pa la dri bzang dang ldan pa'i me tog ser po/ bsod nams rgyas pa la zas mchog /'byor pa rgyas pa la ras dar zab 'bru sman/ rigs brgyud rgyas pa la shing thog /skyon med rnams gang rgyas par 'dod pa de gtso bor bya/ snod kyang rin po che'i rigs ser po dang gru bzhi bya/ stegs kheb dang sgrub po'i chas gos ser po bya bas bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis kha lhor phyogs par 'dug /rje rigs kyi khyim las byung ba'am nor bu las byung ba'i me sbar/ thab lha bskyed skabs/ hūm̐ las rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po dbyibs gruu bzhi mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar rin po che ser po dang*/ kha khyer dang zur bzhir rin po ches mtshan pa dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba/ rgya dpangs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du me yi dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ ser po las dbyug tho ser po ram̐ gyis mtshan par gyur te/ de las me lha ser po drang srong gi cha byad can sha skem tshangs pa'i skud pa ser po dang ldan pa sogs lha bskyed nas brtsams 'jig rten dang 'das pa'i me lha mchod tshul sngar zhi ba'i skabs ltar la/ dmigs bsal gyi kha bsgyur skabs thob mchan gyis gsal ba ltar shes par bya zhing*/ sbyin sreg byas pa'i me dkrugs gdal sogs mi bya bar rang zhir 'jog /long med na dri ser po'i chus gzhil la/

thal sol rnams mdzod phug dang*/ gtsug lag gi phug tu sba ba'o/ /gsum pa dbang gi sbyin sreg ni/ sa chog sngon du 'gro bas tshong 'dus dang smad tshong ma'i gnas kyi sa las byas pa'i thab stegs gru bzhi par rdul tshon dmar po'i bcad tshon kyang dmar skya la sogs pas bya/ tsandan dmar po dang*/ seng ldeng*/ 'o se/ mdzo mo shing sogs kha dog dmar zhing ro skyur ba'i shing zla gam du khru gang brtsigs/ stegs khebs dang*/ sgrub pa po'i chas gos kha dog dmar po dang*/ snod kyang gtso bor zangs dang dbyibs zla gam can du bya/ dbang gi las dmigs bsal la tsandan dmar po'am zangs kyi byang bur gser ram mtshal gyis rtsa sngags sham bur/ a nṛ tri dung dung dzaḥdzaḥ che ge wā shaṃ ku ru ho: zhes bris pa gang mang bsags/ rdzas thams cad kha dog dmar por bcos/ slob dpon kha nub tu phyogs pas pad skyil gyis 'dug cing chags pa'i sems dang sgeg nyams bya/ smad tshong gi khyim las byung ba'i me du ba med pas spar/ me lha bskyed skabs/

hūm̐ las dbang gi thab khung kha dog dmar zhing dbyibs zla gam/ mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma'i lte bar utpal dmar po dang*/ kha khyer la padma'i phreng bas bskor zhing grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba/ rgya dpangs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ dmar po las dbyug tho dmar po ram̐ gyis mtshan par gyur ste/ de las me lha dmar po drang srong gi cha byad can sha skem tshangs pa'i skud pa dmar po dang ldan sogs zhi ba'i skabs ltar la/ dmigs bsal gyi kha bsgyur dkyus su 'khod pa'i mchan ltar dang*/ sreg thal sdod long yod na rang zhi/ med tshe chang dang sbyar ba'i chus gzhil/ thal ba ri mthon po'i rtser rlung la bskur ba'i khyad par dmigs su bsal ba'o/ /bzhi pa drag po'i sbyin sreg ni/ sa yi cho ga dang ldan pas dur khrod brgyad dang 'phung shul las bcos pa'i sa stegs gru bzhi pa'i steng rdul tshon nag po bcad tshon sngo skyas byas pa'i thab 'du bya/ skyer pa la sogs pa'i dug dang tsher ma can gyi shing sor nyi shu pa gru gsum du brtsigs/ stegs kheb dang sgrub pa po'i chas gos nag po dang*/ drag po'i rdzas bdun ni/ me srog 'dzin pa'i rdzas skyer pa dang tsher ma can gyi drag po'i shing gi yam shing zur gsum sor bcu gnyis pa mar nag dang tshil zhun gyis sbag pa/ rtsa ba'i rdzas 'byor na dug shog la dgra bgegs kyi rū pa/ ming rus bla dwags gnad yig dang bcas pa drug cu rtsa bzhi sogs grangs ldan/ drag po'i rdzas sha sna bag phye bsres pa'i ril bu ming rus can/ gnad dbab rdzas sbal sbrul nya khyi la sogs pa'i sha dug sna dang bsres pa'i ril bu bcas/ gsod pa'i rdzas lcags zangs rdo rje'i phye ma/ myos pa'i rdzas mar nag mo mnol gyi khrag dang sbyar ba/

tsha ba'i rdzas til dang yungs kar tsha ba gsum bcas/ lcags kyi snod gru gsum pa 'ba' zhig bya/ lcags dang rdo phye sha chen gyis sbag pa'i gtor ma gru gsum ro sol gyis nag po byas pa dang*/ drag po'i nyer spyod kyang bshams/ mchod sreg gi rdzas g.yas g.yon mgo ldog tu bkod/ slob dpon kha byang du phyogs bas rus sbal gyis 'dug stangs dang khro zhing 'tshigs pa'i sems bya/ shan pa'am dur khrod las byung ba'i me sbar la/ lha bskyed skabs/ hūm̐ las drag po'i thab khung nag po dbyibs gru gsum mu ran kha khyer dang bcas pa'i lte bar rdo rje rgya gram rwa gdeng ba can gyi kha khyer dang zur bzhir ral gris mtshan pa/ dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba/ rgya dpangs sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa dang*/ ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ nag po las dbyug tho nag po ram̐ gyis mtshan par gyur ste de las me lha nag po drang srong gi cha byad can/ sha skem ro skra'i tshangs skud nag po dang ldan pa sogs snga ma rnams ltar/ 'dod gsol rigs kha bsgyur bcas bya zhing*/ long skabs yod med gang ltar yang*/ me dug khrag gis gzhil te lam gyi bzhi mdor mnan pa'i khyad par ro/ /lnga pa mchog gi dngos grub gtso bor byed pa la rgyal rdzas 'dod gsol/ bskyed chog rnams rgyas pa dang mtshungs shing*/ khyad par gyi rdzas bdud rtsi chos sman dang mā da na sindhu ra rnams bsres pa'i zas mchog la gtsor bya gsungs so/ /de ltar bshad nyid rdo rje phag mo rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha sngags la sbyar tshul yin kyang kun mkhyen rdo rje gzi brjid mchog gi zhal nas spyir phag mo rigs gang la bsten kyang las thams cad sgrub tu rung mod gtso bor phag mo dkar mo zhi ba/ ser mos rgyas pa/ dmar mos dbang*/ ljang mos drag po/ nag mos lha mchog gi las la sbyar bas legs shing*/

zhes gsungs pa ltar lha sngags rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro'i so so'i phrin las dang sngar ltar phul kyang rigs dang lha yi nges pas ches zab cing myur phyir skal ldan dag gis 'dod na cho ga'i spyi chings 'di nyid kyis khog phub nas sgos bka' so sor sbyor chog pa yod do/ /spy-ir bka' gter kun nas phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro dang*/ las kyi rno 'don sreg blug gi cho ga 'di nyid ched du bsngags shing bstan pas 'di gnyis ka tshang bas lhag par zab 'gyur che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis sgrub pa chen po'i skabs su nyin dang po'i skabs drag po'i sbyin sreg /nyin gsum pa la dbang*/ dngos grub len pa'i snga rol du rgyas pa/ bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i skabs lta bur mchog /grol rjes zhi ba bcas phyag bzhes su bstar na legs pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ro/ /rang byung lhan skyes ye shes ches myur mes/ /'khrul rtog bud shing zos dang lhan cig par/ /dngos grub snang ba sbyin pa'i cho ga'i tshul/ /brtsams 'dis las kun 'dod rgur dbang byed shog /ces rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rab 'byams phrin las snang ba'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di yang mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid dpal yul rmugs sangs mchog sprul rin po che'i dbu ru byang phyogs do skya dgon pa chos sku 'od 'bar gling du do skya mchog sprul rin po che'i bdag rkyen las zab gsang rdo rje'i gseng lam gyi sgrub chen gtan 'jags gnang ba'i skabs gsung gi nan tan du bskul zhing*/ bri gzhi'i shog dkar/ lha rdzas kyi rten dang bcas bstsal bas sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyas pa'i las 'grigs su 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer rang byung 'od gsal thugs mchog rdo rjes rang lo zhe brgyad pa nag zla'i dkar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang por dbus 'gyur 'chang gi gtsug lag chen po'i shar phyogs lhun grub me tog ldum ra'i gzims shag tu rdzogs par sbyar bas dge legs su gyur cig/
